source_name: 用户提供的平水韵重新抓取文件
integration: The user supplied a newly scraped JSON file outside the project. It was copied into data/rhyme/Pingshui_Rhyme.json and normalized to UTF-8 with LF line endings for stable cross-platform hashing; the external path is intentionally not retained.

entry_schema.senses: source-provided meanings for this character under this section/group membership

limitations: The supplied file contains section, group, character and senses, but no separate pinyin field.
A membership identifies an attested Pingshui section/group and derived ping/ze tone; it must not be presented as a fabricated modern pronunciation.
Empty senses mean the supplied table has no semantic note for that membership, not that every contextual reading is valid.
Source URL, capture time, scraper implementation and redistribution license were not included with the supplied file.
